title: Deferred Cyclotomic Representation for Stable and Exact Evaluation of q-Hypergeometric Series
summary: We introduce a cyclotomic representation for finite $q$-hypergeometric series and $q$-deformed amplitudes that separates algebraic structure from evaluation. By expressing each summand in a sparse exponent basis over irreducible cyclotomic polynomials, all products and ratios of quantum factorials reduce to integer vector arithmetic. This ensures that cancellations between numerator and denominator are resolved exactly prior to any evaluation.
